_about: Proposed SSYS-050 row for per-token colours (pm7-editor-customizer, 2026-10-14; Jared asked for the token colour editor; PROPOSAL-canon.md section 3c). Inventory shape; build.py's EDITOR_LOOK_ROWS block admits it until canon holds its id. Edited in the editor's Customize screen (Colors, Token colours); Settings shows and clears the stored map.

rows.label: Token Colors
rows.desc: Your own colour for one kind of word (keywords, strings, comments and the other 14 the editor colours) in one scheme, kept as scheme/kind and #rrggbb, such as dracula/kw: #ff79c6. A colour that would read under the editor's text contrast is drawn a little lighter or darker, its hue kept. Set them in the editor's Customize screen, under Colors.
